[[General/Legends|General]] '''Ka'un Damm''', nicknamed ''the Butcher'', was an [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Hadiya]] during the [[Despot War]]. After the defeat of the [[Despot Army]] at the [[Battle of Tython]], Damm was banished from his homeworld of [[Shikaakwa]] and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] on [[Nox (planet)|Nox]] with the other Generals of Hadiya's Inner Circle.
